scope: Verified actual GUI workflow; multilingual media not yet complete

oracle_validation.scope: Independent uint16 histogram percentiles, full source arrays and layer-state checks, 71x71 actual screen samples in each of 26 display states, deterministic label colours and five blend modes; not every screen pixel or arbitrary multichannel/3D/soft-coverage layers.

scope_limits: Reuse the verified fov01 TIFF pair from the External Masks tutorial: a 1994×1994 uint16 intensity plane and aligned 44-object cell-label plane. They exactly match planes 1 and 4 of the preserved acquired plate1_E01_1_1 array, with 3,976,036 pixels and no physical calibration supplied. Neutral fov01 filenames are not acquisition metadata. Private copies and all originals remain byte-identical. Nineteen small oracle tests and observed-red mutations accompany independent checks of 5,041 actual screen pixels in each of 26 states, with zero RGB-byte discrepancy. Full source arrays, histogram-derived 2/98 contrast limits, layer properties and gesture geometry are also checked; this is not complete pixel-by-pixel validation of arbitrary layers, multichannel/3D data, soft coverage, biological segmentation accuracy or physical calibration. Fit can stretch the image to its pane. No pipeline, AI request, image editing, direct export, linked-view object handoff or Points/Shapes drawing was performed. This screen's controls differ from the other image previews.
The actual wide-pane Fit stretches the source: y step 1.2249025398700533 and x step 0.6638156209987197. Native divider resize yields an approximately square pane; no application fix is claimed.
A bare GUI-loaded mask has field=None and selected_label=0. The demonstrated click reports label9 and world coordinates, but emits no experiment-wide object selection.
Native Plus Points and Plus Shapes add empty layers; ordinary clicks add no geometry. Removing layers changes only this view. No drawing/export/pipeline/AI action is claimed.
